summary: Iteration 54: Race Condition Fix Testing Complete. All 7 backend tests passed. Frontend verification confirmed that when editing quote quo_3264aef5eeb5, setup items load with their SAVED values (cajas=15, descuento_setup=10%, descuento_recurrente=5%) instead of resetting to defaults. The fix correctly differentiates between initial load (preserve DB values) and user changes (propagate header values).

issues: React hydration warnings (cosmetic) - tr inside span, span inside tbody - caused by Emergent Visual Editor wrapper. Does not affect functionality.

details: When editing quote quo_3264aef5eeb5, Cajas header shows 15 (NOT reset to 1)
Setup items load with cantidad_cajas=15 from database
Bancos/Entes header shows 2 from database
prevCajasRef and prevBancosRef refs track values to detect real user changes vs load
After manually changing Cajas from 15 to 20, all setup items update to 20
All recurring items also update Cajas to 20
Totals recalculate correctly ($500.00 subtotal setup)
useEffect correctly detects value change via refs and propagates
QuoteItem model includes lockBancos, autoBancos, bancosOverride, totalOverride, isAutoLinked
'Suscripción PDV/Banco' saved with lockBancos=false (editable)
'Derecho de uso... por PDV' saved with lockBancos=true (shows N/A in UI)
'Derecho de uso... por PDV / Banco' saved with lockBancos=false (editable Bancos field)
useEffect for autoBancos has isLoadingEdit guard (line 230)
Prevents auto-calculation from overwriting saved values during edit load
'Configuración Medio de Pago / Banco...' preserves saved cantidad_bancos=2
descuento_setup=10% persisted and loaded correctly
descuento_recurrente=5% persisted and loaded correctly
Discount amounts calculated correctly (-$22.50 setup, -$5.63 recurrente)
'Derecho de uso de plataforma MServer por PDV' (without /Banco) shows N/A in Bancos
'Derecho de uso de plataforma MServer por PDV / Banco' shows editable Bancos=2
Exact/longest match logic prevents shorter concept from matching first

test_cases.name: User change propagates correctly
test_cases.verification: Changed Cajas from 15 to 20, all items updated correctly

critical_code_review_comments: Race condition fix uses refs (prevCajasRef, prevBancosRef) to track previous values and detect real user changes
isLoadingEdit guard in autoBancos useEffect prevents auto-calculation during load
Propagation useEffect checks if values actually changed before propagating
QuoteItem model includes all metadata fields (lockBancos, autoBancos, bancosOverride, totalOverride, isAutoLinked)
Concept matching uses exact match first, then longest partial match to avoid ambiguity
seed_data_creation: Used existing quote quo_3264aef5eeb5 created with cajas=15, bancos=2, descuento_setup=10, descuento_recurrente=5, lockBancos metadata per item
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 54 verified the RACE CONDITION fix in quote editing: 1) prevCajasRef and prevBancosRef refs track header values to distinguish user changes from isLoadingEdit flag changes 2) isLoadingEdit guard in autoBancos useEffect prevents auto-calculation during load 3) QuoteItem model persists lockBancos, autoBancos, bancosOverride, totalOverride, isAutoLinked metadata 4) Frontend correctly loads saved values (cajas=15) on edit, not default values 5) After user manually changes header, propagation works correctly
